research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: www.maybank.co.id is not bot-protected; every document was downloaded directly with curl from the URL stored in source_url (2026-11-03). Report lists come from the IR pages' AJAX endpoint /api/sitecore/Reports/FinancialReportsListPaging (quarterly published reports and consolidated FS). The FY2020 deck and the 2022-2025 dividend notices are not linked on the current pages but are live at the URLs given. No Internet Archive copies were needed.

GROUP SCOPE: consolidated figures include PT Wahana Ottomitra Multiartha Tbk (WOM Finance) and PT Maybank Indonesia Finance (Maybank Finance). On 4 Aug 2026 the bank acquired 51% of PT Maybank Asset Management, 51% (direct + indirect via Maybank Finance) of PT Maybank Sekuritas Indonesia and 51% of PT Asuransi Etiqa Internasional Indonesia from Maybank Group entities, for cash, to become the operating financial holding company (PIKK) of the Maybank financial conglomerate (EGMS 29 Jun 2026; 9M2026 FS Note 1b). These are common-control combinations (pooling of interests, PSAK 338), so the 9M2026 FS restates the comparatives (Note 59): 31 Dec 2025 TA 199,199.038 (orig. 193,717.633), loans & sharia financing 116,053.864 (116,330.305), deposits 116,021.249 (116,194.096), equity attributable 32,458.339 (32,453.307), total equity 33,959.807 (33,083.483). 9M2025 profit attributable is unchanged (989.387). fy.* keeps the figures as originally reported; interim.* uses the 9M2026 scope.

LOANS DEFINITION: loans_gross = the AR's 'Loans' line (footnote: includes consumer financing receivables of the multifinance subsidiaries), gross of allowances; it equals FS 'Kredit yang diberikan dan piutang/pembiayaan Syariah' (gross) + 'Piutang pembiayaan konsumen' net of unearned income in every year (components in each note). The bare FS loan line is about 7-11 tn lower. Analyst decks use the same 'Total loans' definition (e.g. FY2025 Rp123.6tn).

RESTATEMENTS: (1) FY2022 FS restated FY2021 and the 1 Jan 2021 balance for the DSAK-IAI press release on attribution of benefits to periods of service (PSAK 24): FY2021 profit attributable 1,644.970 -> 1,666.316, EPS 21.58 -> 21.86, TA 168,758.476 -> 168,712.977, equity attributable 28,301.139 -> 28,458.762; FY2020 TA 173,224.412 -> 173,190.035, equity attributable 26,837.593 -> 26,956.128. (2) 9M2026 FS restated 2025 (see GROUP SCOPE). fy.* stores the figures as originally reported in each year's audited FS, with the restated values in the notes. The FY2021 dividend was based on the original 1,644.970.

RATIO BASIS: FY2021-FY2025 ratios come from the AR2025 'Financial Ratios' highlight table and FY2020 from AR2024's. These are CONSOLIDATED: they equal the KONSOLIDASIAN column of the OJK published report (checked Dec 2025) and the 'Consolidated' column of each FY deck. The AR footnote marks only LDR (and GWM/PLM/NOP) as bank only, so ldr is stored bank_only (regulatory LDR). Consolidated LDR is much higher because it includes consumer financing receivables: 89.10/86.18/98.31/96.32/101.85/103.62% for 2020-2025. ROE is the OJK Tier-1-based ROE (decks: 'Return On Equity (Tier 1)'). CIR 2020 (59.66%) comes from the AR2023 MD&A table, because AR2024's highlight table has no CIR row. CASA (consolidated) comes from each FY deck. LAR is bank only (AR MD&A / decks); no consolidated LAR is disclosed. CoC and NPL coverage are not disclosed as ratios in any AR or deck checked, so they are null.

RATIO VINTAGES: the AR2025 table prints FY2021 ratios after the PSAK 24 restatement (originally ROA 1.32, ROE 6.29, CAR 26.91, BOPO 82.90, CIR 59.92) and FY2022 NIM/CIR after a later reclassification (originally 5.05% / 64.18% in the FY2022 deck). The latest values are stored and the originals are given in the notes. As a result, FY2021 ratios are on the restated basis while FY2021 levels are as originally reported (difference about 1%).

AR MISPRINTS NOTED (not used): AR2025 MD&A key-ratio table (PDF p. 209) has shifted labels: its 'NPL gross' row 1.97% is CKPN/earning assets, 'NPL net' 2.17% is gross NPL, etc. The highlight table on PDF p. 30 is consistent and was used. AR2020 MD&A (PDF p. 207) has the 'Consolidated'/'Individual' column headers swapped. AR2025 dividend table prints the FY2022 total as 1.471.1 (= net profit; correct 588.4). The FY2024 dividend notice prints DPS Rp5.84691 (correct Rp5.85691 per the AGMS resolution and total/shares).

DIVIDENDS: exactly one cash dividend (final) out of each FY2020-FY2025 profit; no interim or special dividends. Each statement of changes in equity shows one payment per year: 253.2 (2021), 493.5 (2022), 588.4 (2023), 784.5 (2024), 446.4 (2025), 580.1 (9M2026). No FY2026 interim dividend as of the 9M2026 FS. The OJK published report for Sep 2026 shows 'Dividen yang dibayarkan' (1,026,464) because that format re-adds the prior-year 446,385 to 'tahun-tahun lalu'; the actual 2026 payment is 580,079 (9M2026 FS PDF p. 365/368). Payouts: 20/30/40/45/40/35%. All dividend dates come from the bank's own notices, except FY2020 (AR2021 chronology).

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-03: none. Issued shares have been 76,215,195,821 since Rights Issue (PUT) VIII in June 2018 (8,468,355,091 Series D shares at Rp236), with no treasury shares, splits, reverse splits, bonus issues or rights issues since then. Sources: AR2025 PDF pp. 132-133 share-listing chronology ('In 2025 Maybank Indonesia did not hold any corporate actions which caused changes in its outstanding shares'); the share count in every FY FS from 2019 to 2025; the 9M2026 FS Note 28. The 2026 subsidiary acquisitions were paid in cash and no BNII shares were issued. The last reverse split was 10:1 on 19 Jun 2002. corporate_actions is therefore an empty list.

INTERIM: 9M2026 (30 Sep 2026), from the unaudited 9M2026 consolidated FS, the OJK quarterly published report (ratios, both columns) and the 30 Oct 2026 press release (loans total, CASA). No 9M2026 analyst deck was posted yet (the latest is 1H2026). Interim ratios use the same bases as fy.* (consolidated; LDR and LAR bank only). Interim LAR is OJK's new 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah' row (see note). The prior-period balances (loans/deposits 30 Sep 2025) are as originally reported, i.e. before the 2026 scope change; the effect is about 0.2% (see notes). Profit 9M2026 956.855 vs 989.387 (-3.3% YoY).

SELF-CHECK: eps x 76,215,195,821 vs net_profit_attr: 2020 +0.028%, 2021 -0.015%, 2022 -0.008%, 2023 -0.021%, 2024 -0.015%, 2025 +0.019%. DPS x shares vs total: all within 0.01%. profit x payout vs total: all within 0.01% (FY2021 uses the original profit). No validation_ack needed.

KBMI 3 per AR2025 (POJK 12/POJK.03/2021). Sharia: Maybank Indonesia is a conventional bank with a sharia business unit (UUS; sharia financing = 29.2% of bank-only financing at Sep 2026 per the 9M2026 press release). Group loans/financing include the UUS, so sharia=false and there are no label_overrides.

validation_ack.reason: Maybank Indonesia AR2020 (PDF p. 36, Share Highlights) prints Q4-2020 high 340 / low 202 / close 318 and a market cap of 318 x 76,215,195,821 shares; that close equals the 23 Dec 2020 session in the price source, which then shows sessions on 28-30 Dec 2020 trading up to Rp416 (above the AR Q4 high) and closing the year at Rp346. The AR table appears to stop at 23 Dec 2020. Neither source is edited: fundamentals keep the AR figure, prices/BNII.json keeps the price source bars.
